_comment: Config-driven platform-action rewards (CG-0MUZGBS9A002X9DQ). Each rule maps a (platform, action) to a target (game or DLC); 'actionUrls' is the page opened for the player to perform the action; 'verifiers' selects the verification method per rule/action/platform. Nothing here is hard-coded in logic: game ids and scene keys are validated against bonus-catalog.json by action-rewards-config.ts. itch.io exposes no follow-detection API, so the itch.io follow resolves to the manual self-attest verifier (documented honour-system caveat). The dev/simulate-purchase rule is a dev/QA-only simulated purchase: it is scoped by rule id and only verifies when a caller explicitly requests simulatePurchase, so a global self-attest refresh can never collateral-unlock it.
